design: Frozen deterministic evaluation authored without inspecting retrieval outputs; no ranking adjustment from this set. Synthetic local corpus, not live provider evidence.

pages.title: Auth Cache
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set authcachettl to 45 seconds to bound credential cache lifetime.

pages.title: Audit Window
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set auditwindowdays to 21 to retain security events.

pages.title: Batch Limit
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set batchmaxrecords to 300 to cap each import batch.

pages.title: Cert Pinning
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set certpinsha256 to the trusted certificate digest.

pages.title: Dns Timeout
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set dnstimeoutms to 800 for resolver waits.

pages.title: Event Retry
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set eventretrycount to four for transient delivery failures.

pages.title: File Lock
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set filelockwaitms to 600 before reporting lock contention.

pages.title: Graph Depth
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set graphmaxdepth to six when traversing related pages.

pages.title: Http Idle
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set httpidlelimit to 90 seconds for pooled connections.

pages.title: Index Shard
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set indexshardcount to eight for this collection.

pages.title: Job Deadline
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set jobdeadlinems to 120000 for worker jobs.

pages.title: Key Rotation
pages.body:
# Configuration
Set keyrotationdays to 30 for signing keys.

pages.title: Backup
pages.body:
# Procedure
Restore a backup only after verifying the manifest checksum.

pages.title: Incident
pages.body:
# Procedure
Escalate a critical incident to the on-call owner within ten minutes.

pages.title: Quota
pages.body:
# Procedure
A request that exceeds the tenant quota receives a bounded rejection.

pages.title: Schema
pages.body:
# Procedure
A schema change must publish a new generation before readers switch.

pages.title: Token
pages.body:
# Procedure
Revoke a leaked token before issuing its replacement.

pages.title: Checkpoint
pages.body:
# Procedure
A completed checkpoint records the last committed sequence.

pages.title: Transport
pages.body:
# Procedure
Retry transport failures with a shared request budget.

pages.title: Retention
pages.body:
# Procedure
Expired records are removed only after a reachability sweep.

pages.title: Issuer
pages.body:
# Procedure
Check the issuer signature before accepting the assertion.

pages.title: Audience
pages.body:
# Procedure
Check the audience claim against the configured service.

pages.title: Source
pages.body:
# Procedure
Confirm the source digest before starting an import.

pages.title: Destination
pages.body:
# Procedure
Confirm destination capacity before starting an import.

pages.title: Rollback
pages.body:
# Procedure
Keep the preceding generation available during rollback.

pages.title: Pin
pages.body:
# Procedure
Pin active readers until they release the preceding generation.

pages.title: Protocol guidance
pages.body:
# Handshake
Use the compatibility handshake for protocol version one.

pages.title: Protocol guidance
pages.body:
# Handshake
Use the signed handshake for protocol version two.

pages.title: Archive option
pages.body:
# Archive
Set archiveflushsize to 512 for the last mount.

pages.title: Archive option
pages.body:
# Archive
Ordinary archive settings are described here.
